title: The model comparisons have the canonical geometric section normalization.
statement: For Λ,A,a, a cartesian affine closed-fibre square (f,h,fZ) with affine X, and a w-contractible affine closed-site test V whose specified lift is w-contractible, take K in D+(Modules Λ X), a K-injective representative e:QI≅K and a K-injective resolution j:h*I→J. There are isomorphisms eC,eD from the derived source and target evaluation expressions to Q(I(T)),Q(J(T0)), and a natural evaluation-versus-localized-sections isomorphism eV. Their inverses are exactly sourceUnit,targetUnit and their evaluation hom is evaluationLocalization. They satisfy the two displayed geometric sectionComparison normalization equations in NormalizedComparisons of [def-sfb-closed-test-localized-model-data]. No restriction map is assumed invertible. In addition both localizationUnit maps on the supplied I and J are invertible; these are the normalized localization comparisons of [lem-sfb-closed-test-kinjective-section-models].

source.place: Tags 0D6E, 0D6F, 0D6G; sites-modules.tex 04IF; derived.tex 070Y; proetale.tex 09BL. Strict part of the original coherence proof.

proof.text:
Use the three normalized isomorphisms of closed-test K-injective section models.
Their composites give eC and eD with the prescribed inverses. The normalized K-injective localization comparisons are isomorphisms. On the target, cancel the image of the supplied resolution representative isomorphism; this gives invertibility of the actual target localizationUnit, while the source is the direct normalized localization comparison. The slice evaluation
comparison gives eV and its hom is the actual evaluationLocalization. Compute the
canonical sectionComparison on the supplied K-injective representative by the
right-derived direct-image composition formula. Its ordinary section formula is the
identity. For the source compose this identity with the actual closed unit and invert
that unit using closed-test unit evaluation. For the target use the literal direct-image
section formula and transport Q(j) through its specified inverse. The universal
right-derived units and exact pullback factors give exactly the two asserted equations;
no geometric restriction map has been assumed invertible.
 The input declarations are [lem-sfb-closed-test-kinjective-section-models], [lem-sfb-closed-test-unit-evaluation], [lem-sfb-unbounded-sections-localization], [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition].

theorem closed_test_derived_comparison_normalization
    [IsAffine X]
    (V : (Spec (.of (A ⧸ 𝔞))).AffineProEt)
    [IsWContractibleRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)]
    [IsWContractibleRing Γ(((Scheme.AffineProEt.closedSiteLift A 𝔞).obj V).left, ⊤)]
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Modules Λ X))
    (I : CochainComplex (Modules Λ X) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective]
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj I ≅ K.obj)
    (J : CochainComplex (Modules Λ XZ) ℤ) [J.IsKInjective]
    (j : ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ h).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶ J)
    [QuasiIso j] :
    IsIso (localizationUnit Λ (sourceTest A 𝔞 f V) I) ∧
    IsIso (localizationUnit Λ (targetTest A 𝔞 fZ V) J) ∧
    NormalizedComparisons Λ A 𝔞 f h fZ V I J j
